items.descriptor: Evaluate whether the Scrum Master builds team capability and self-management without becoming the team's manager.

entries.descriptor: Helps team members strengthen self-management, facilitation, conflict navigation, and collective ownership.
Helps the team improve value flow and effectiveness without taking ownership of its decisions.

items.descriptor: Evaluate whether the Scrum Master helps the team focus on valuable, usable outcomes and meaningful goals.

entries.descriptor: Keeps attention on valuable, usable increments that meet the Definition of Done.
Helps the team create a coherent Sprint Goal, inspect progress, and adapt its plan without manufacturing commitment.

items.descriptor: Evaluate whether the Scrum Master improves flow by making impediments visible and enabling durable removal.

entries.descriptor: Makes impediments visible and helps the right owners remove them promptly.
Uses flow evidence to help the team reduce avoidable waiting, handoffs, and work in progress.

items.descriptor: Evaluate whether Scrum events enable focused transparency, inspection, adaptation, and inclusive decisions.

entries.descriptor: Ensures each Scrum event serves its inspection-and-adaptation purpose and produces a useful outcome.
Facilitates inclusive participation, candid inspection, and ownership of improvement actions.

items.descriptor: Evaluate whether the Scrum Master supports effective Product Ownership without assuming the Product Owner's accountability.

entries.descriptor: Helps the Product Owner and developers keep the Product Backlog transparent, ordered, and sufficiently understood.
Facilitates a clear, measurable Product Goal grounded in stakeholder and customer evidence.
Helps the Product Owner reconcile stakeholder needs while preserving clear product accountability.

items.descriptor: Evaluate whether planning responds to evidence, uncertainty, and learning in complex work.

entries.descriptor: Helps product planning use short feedback loops, explicit assumptions, and evidence in complex conditions.
Helps the team adapt scope and plans when evidence changes while protecting the Product and Sprint Goals.

items.descriptor: Evaluate whether the Scrum Master enables direct, productive collaboration around product outcomes.

entries.descriptor: Creates effective, accessible collaboration between the Scrum Team and relevant internal and external stakeholders.
Helps participants align on product outcomes and explicit priorities rather than relying on activity or project-output measures alone.

items.descriptor: Evaluate whether the Scrum Master teaches, coaches, and influences the wider system effectively.

entries.descriptor: Teaches and coaches the organization on Scrum accountabilities, empiricism, and the limits of the framework.
Advocates for transparency, inspection, adaptation, and verified improvement in complex work.

items.descriptor: Evaluate whether the Scrum Master addresses organizational boundaries that obstruct the Scrum Team.

entries.descriptor: Works with leaders and stakeholders to remove organizational barriers that prevent direct, timely collaboration.
Builds communication patterns that surface disagreements, decisions, and feedback without bypassing product accountability.
